sanskrit: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् । जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
hindiTranslation: छल करनेवालोंमें जूआ और तेजस्वियोंमें तेज मैं हूँ ।  जीतनेवालोंकी विजय, निश्चय करनेवालोंका निश्चय और सात्त्विक मनुष्योंका सात्त्विक भाव मैं हूँ ॥
englishTranslation: Among deceivers I am gambling, among the vigorous I am splendor. I am victory, I am resolve, and I am the goodness of the good.
essence: What shines through victory and resolve is not separate from the divine.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Krishna says he is present as the force behind victory, determination, and the goodness found in noble people.
simpleInsight: Your best qualities are not isolated achievements; they are signs of a larger presence moving through you.
detailedMeaning: Krishna keeps naming where divine power appears in ordinary and extraordinary forms. Here Krishna says that even victory, firm resolve, and noble character are expressions of him.
modernRelevance: After weeks of dithering, a woman finally refuses to co-sign her brother's loan and feels steady saying it. Krishna calls that steadiness resolve, and he says it comes from him.
translationLiteral: द्यूतम् (gambling) / छलयताम् (among deceivers) / अस्मि (I am) / तेजः (splendor) / तेजस्विनाम् (of the vigorous) / अहम् (I) / जयः (victory) / अस्मि (I am) / व्यवसायः (resolve) / अस्मि (I am) / सत्त्वम् (goodness) / सत्त्ववताम् (of the good) / अहम् (I am)
insight: Krishna surprisingly names gambling among the deceivers' arts, alongside victory, resolve and the goodness of the good.

quoteVariants.text: I am victory, resolve, and the force that shines through the good.
Even your resolve is carrying My force.
Victory, resolve, goodness: all are Mine.
